_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); software signals

pit_profile.why: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products, by offering an array of services, including cloud-based services to consumers and businesses, by designing, manufacturing, and selling devices that integrate with our cloud-based services, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience'; 'Our increasing focus on services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us using an open source business model'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2015 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: Microsoft's own FY2015 10-K, under 'Our increasing focus on services presents execution and competitive risks.', says 'At the same time, our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers. Pricing and delivery models are evolving.' and 'These costs will reduce the operating margins we have previously achieved.' It competes with cloud services of its own: 'We are devoting significant resources to develop and deploy our cloud-based strategies.' The stock trades at 16.7x FY16E — a premium. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (CLOUD) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing cloud substitution of Microsoft's licensed software specifically.

classification.quality_note: Microsoft: 'We generate revenue by developing, licensing, and supporting a wide range of software products, by offering an array of services, including cloud-based services to consumers and businesses, by designing, manufacturing, and selling devices that integrate with our cloud-based services, and by delivering relevant online advertising to a global audience'; 'Our increasing focus on services presents execution and competitive risks': 'our competitors are rapidly developing and deploying cloud-based services for consumers and business customers'; 'Business model competition': 'Some companies compete with us using an open source business model'; 'We face intense competition across all markets for our products and services, which may lead to lower revenue or operating margins' (its own FY2015 10-K): a competition and business-model risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 3.08x; +67% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.09; conservative 2yr -10%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -24.2%/yr (worst year FY06-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.7%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +8.4%/yr (FY06-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +27.7%/yr (best 2-yr run FY06-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MSFT (retrospective, 2015-09-25) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 3.08x (63.6% downside to Bear $16 / +20.6% upside to Bull $53) | Adj composite 1.98 vs market 3.07: gap -1.09 [OVERVALUED] | +67% above the EPP floor $26 (10x FY16E $2.63) | Conservative 2-yr case: -10.4% total (-5.2%/yr) | At 16.7x FY16E the 15% hurdle price $58 sits above the BULL case; unearned revenue +0.6% in Q4 FY15, forward revenues -2% (no Q1 FY16 revenue guide, Q4 FY15 revenue ex-currency); cloud is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
